column1: #   The Agora RTSA RTM image-upload first-send path performs a one-shot
#   internal allocation of ~312 KB (aosl_malloc 319296) for its TLS /
#   session context. Combined with the SDK's long-lived RTC + RTM state
#   AP_PSRAM_HEAP could not satisfy that 312 KB transient and the SDK
#   has no graceful fallback). We grow AP_PSRAM_HEAP by +0x80000 (512 KB)
#   to 0x166000 (1.4 MB) and shrink the PSRAM_MEM_SLAB_CODED slab by the
#   same amount. Reserve another 0x1000 (4 KB) from
#   AP_PSRAM_CODE_SECTION for AP_PSRAM_NOCACHE_HEAP while keeping the
#   enlarged AP heap and CODED slab unchanged.
#   The CODED slab currently only hosts the LVGL primary
#   framebuffer (~560 KB) plus minor on-demand H.264 encoder / NN tensor
